items.title: 輝達提前喊明年再成長70% 黃仁勳一關鍵詞藏底氣
items.title_en: Nvidia Forecasts 70% Growth Next Year, Jensen Huang Hints at Confidence with a Key Word
paras: 《The Motley Fool》刊文分析指出，輝達 (NVDA-US) 提前提出2028會計年度營收成長70%的展望，背後支撐來自公司對AI供應鏈與資料中心建設的深入參與。從晶片、記憶體到土地與電力，輝達掌握的資訊已涵蓋整座AI工廠，有助於提前評估需求與部署能力。
分析師 Adam Spatacco 於文中指出，黃仁勳在第二季財報電話會議中，僅提過一次「能見度」(visibility)，卻點出輝達敢於提出長期成長預測的關鍵。
有別於過去不願提供如此長期預測的做法，輝達管理層表示，若單看產品需求，2028會計年度營收成長幅度可以明顯超過70%；考量硬體供應限制後，70%是公司認為能夠達成的成長底線。
支撐這項展望的需求，首先來自大型雲端業者持續擴張的AI投資。文章指出，五大AI超大規模雲端業者2026年資本支出預估接近8,000億美元，2027年將增至1.3兆美元，雲端業務待履約訂單則約達2兆美元。
大型雲端業者目前約占輝達資料中心業務的一半，其餘來自新興AI雲端業者、主權AI計畫，以及工業與企業客戶。文章指出，歸類為AI雲端、工業與企業客群 (ACIE) 的業務，成長速度甚至更快。
除了客戶支出，輝達也透過與全球土地、電力及資料中心建物業者合作，掌握多年期開發與電力接網計畫，再結合晶圓、記憶體及光學元件的供應資訊，提前規畫未來部署所需的運算能力。
隨著參與範圍擴大，輝達的競爭重心也從個別晶片轉向整座AI工廠，將CPU、GPU、網路、軟體及實體場址納入協同設計。每GW電力容量對應的建置成本，已從Hopper時代約180億美元，增至Blackwell的250億美元，Vera Rubin則達400億美元，輝達也有機會從中取得更大的商機。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 對Marvell、諾基亞與Coherent的持股，同樣反映這項布局方向。Marvell提供客製化加速器與支援NVLink Fusion的矽光子技術；諾基亞協助拓展AI無線接取網路 (AI-RAN)；Coherent則支援光互連骨幹，因應晶片叢集擴大後，對光連接取代銅線的需求。
不過，AI投資熱潮仍面臨獲利與競爭考驗。市場疑慮包括循環融資交易、部分大型業者資本支出超過營運現金流，以及亞馬遜、Alphabet、微軟與Meta自行開發AI加速器，可能削弱輝達的定價能力。懷疑者也擔心，AI建設可能重演1990年代末期光纖基礎設施擴張過快、獲利應用未能跟上的情況。
成本上升則是另一項壓力。輝達已警告，記憶體價格上漲將壓抑毛利率，影響延續至明年。Spatacco認為，公司與美光、SK海力士及三星等主要供應商的合作，加上對下游建設需求的掌握，有助於提前調整架構、鎖定產能與供應協議，並管理客戶預期。
在Spatacco看來，記憶體漲價帶來的短期獲利壓力，與需求因市場情緒逆轉而消失，應分開評估。已落實於土地、電力及關鍵零組件配置的需求，加上輝達在整座AI工廠中持續擴大的參與程度，仍是他看好公司長期成長的主要依據。
paras_en: The Motley Fool analysis notes that Nvidia (NVDA-US) has early‑stated a 70% revenue growth outlook for the 2028 fiscal year, backed by the company’s deep involvement in the AI supply chain and data‑center build‑out. From chips and memory to land and power, Nvidia’s information covers the entire AI factory, helping it assess demand and deployment capacity ahead of time.

Analyst Adam Spatacco points out that during the Q2 earnings call, Jensen Huang mentioned “visibility” only once, yet highlighted it as the key to Nvidia’s willingness to make a long‑term growth forecast.

Unlike its past reluctance to give such long‑range guidance, Nvidia’s management says that if only product demand were considered, revenue growth for FY2028 could far exceed 70%; after accounting for hardware supply constraints, 70% is the growth floor the company believes it can achieve.

The demand supporting this outlook comes first from large cloud providers’ continued AI investment. The article estimates the five biggest hyperscale cloud players will spend nearly $800 billion on capex in 2026, rising to $1.3 trillion in 2027, with about $2 trillion of cloud‑service backlog orders.

Large cloud providers currently account for roughly half of Nvidia’s data‑center business, with the rest coming from emerging AI cloud players, sovereign AI projects, and industrial and enterprise customers. The article notes that the segment classified as AI Cloud, Industrial and Enterprise (ACIE) is growing even faster.

Beyond customer spend, Nvidia also partners with global land, power and data‑center developers to secure multi‑year development and power‑grid connection plans, combining that with supply information on wafers, memory and optical components to pre‑plan the compute capacity needed for future deployments.

As its scope expands, Nvidia’s competitive focus shifts from individual chips to the whole AI factory, integrating CPU, GPU, networking, software and physical sites into a coordinated design. The build cost per GW of power capacity has risen from about $18 billion in the Hopper era to $25 billion for Blackwell and $40 billion for Vera Rubin, giving Nvidia larger business opportunities.

Nvidia’s holdings in Marvell, Nokia and Coherent also reflect this strategy. Marvell provides custom accelerators and NVLink‑Fusion silicon‑photonic technology; Nokia helps expand AI‑RAN wireless access networks; Coherent supports optical‑interconnect backbones needed as chip clusters grow and copper‑wire links are replaced.

However, the AI investment boom still faces profitability and competition challenges. Market concerns include cyclical financing deals, some large players’ capex outpacing operating cash flow, and Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft and Meta building their own AI accelerators, which could erode Nvidia’s pricing power. Skeptics also fear AI infrastructure could repeat the late‑1990s fiber‑optic over‑expansion where profit‑driving applications lagged behind.

Rising costs are another pressure. Nvidia has warned that higher memory prices will compress margins, affecting results into next year. Spatacco believes the company’s collaborations with Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung, together with its grasp of downstream construction demand, help it adjust architecture, lock in capacity and supply agreements, and manage customer expectations.

In Spatacco’s view, the short‑term profit pressure from memory price hikes should be evaluated separately from demand that could vanish if market sentiment reverses. The realized demand for land, power and key component allocations, combined with Nvidia’s growing role in the entire AI factory, remains the main basis for his confidence in the company’s long‑term growth.

items.title: 川普批龐巴迪「產品不夠好」揚言不赴美生產就禁止在美銷售
items.title_en: Trump Says Bombardier’s “Products Not Good Enough,” Threatens Ban on U.S. Sales Without Domestic Production
paras: 美國總統川普周一(7日)表示，加拿大私人飛機製造商龐巴迪(Bombardier)若希望繼續在美國市場銷售飛機，就必須在美國境內生產，否則將不再獲准銷售。川普並批評龐巴迪產品品質不佳，進一步升高美加之間的貿易緊張關係。
川普周一在Truth Social發文表示，「NO MORE SELLING BOMBARDIER IN THE UNITED STATES! Their products aren’t good enough!」並稱，如果龐巴迪想要美國市場，「就必須在這裡生產」，同時停止把美國當成「提款機」。
川普此番言論正值美國與加拿大貿易爭端持續升溫之際。加拿大預計周二(8日)對美國推出一波報復性關稅，華府與渥太華之間的摩擦已從關稅措施進一步延伸至個別企業與產業。
白宮尚未立即說明川普將如何落實這項針對龐巴迪的措施，也未交代將採取何種法律或行政手段阻止已獲美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)核准的龐巴迪飛機交付美國客戶。龐巴迪生產的商務機同時符合美國、墨西哥與加拿大協定(USMCA)的相關規定，而該協定正是川普第一任期推動建立的北美貿易架構。
美國航空航太分析師Richard Aboulafia認為，川普的最新威脅不太可能導致商務機客戶取消龐巴迪訂單，也難以看出川普政府究竟能如何阻止這些飛機在美國市場銷售。他指出，龐巴迪多數私人飛機採用美國製造的引擎，供應商包括Honeywell Aerospace(HON-US)與GE Aerospace(GE-US)，因此美國本土企業本身也深度參與龐巴迪飛機的生產鏈。
航空航太產業目前也是川普關稅政策中相對未受到重大衝擊的領域，零組件與飛機的跨境流動目前並未普遍受到關稅影響。美國航空航太工業協會(Aerospace Industries Association)數據顯示，美國航空航太與國防產業2025年創造1092億美元貿易順差，出口年增25%。
分析人士指出，航空航太產業與美國汽車產業類似，都高度依賴跨境供應鏈。美加兩國的航空航太製造體系經過多年整合，零組件、引擎、機翼、維修與服務網絡均跨越國境，因此若限制加拿大製造的飛機進入美國市場，可能同時牽動美國企業與供應商。
總部位於蒙特婁的龐巴迪是美國商務機製造商Gulfstream Aerospace的競爭對手。龐巴迪目前在美國擁有約3500名員工，並與約2800家美國供應商合作，同時在美國設有多座工廠與服務中心。公司目前正籌建第6座美國服務中心，並已在德州生產其旗艦Global 8000私人飛機的機翼。
龐巴迪同時經營國防業務，在堪薩斯州設有美國工廠，負責將加拿大製造的飛機改裝為特殊任務用途。從客戶機隊所在地來看，龐巴迪客戶目前營運的約5100架飛機中，大約一半位於美國，顯示美國市場對公司業務的重要性。
截至目前，龐巴迪尚未立即回應外界對川普最新言論的置評要求。
這並非川普首次針對龐巴迪採取強硬立場。今年1月，川普曾表示，美國將取消龐巴迪Global Express商務機的認證，並威脅對所有在加拿大製造的飛機課徵50%進口關稅，直到加拿大監管機構核准一定數量的Gulfstream飛機。不過，川普當時威脅的兩項措施最終均未實施；隔月，加拿大則核准數款Gulfstream飛機。
龐巴迪最新財報也顯示，公司目前仍受惠於私人航空市場及售後服務需求。公司7月公布季度業績，季度營收較去年同期成長6%，達21.5億美元，主要受強勁的售後服務需求帶動。
對龐巴迪而言，美國不僅是重要銷售市場，也是其生產與供應鏈的重要基地，因此川普要求公司「在美國製造」的最新表態，實際上可能迫使龐巴迪進一步擴大美國投資與製造布局。另一方面，若美國政府真的限制加拿大製造飛機進口，如何與現有FAA認證、USMCA架構及跨境供應鏈規則銜接，也將成為後續政策能否落地的關鍵。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 7th) that Canadian private‑jet maker Bombardier must produce its aircraft in the United States if it wants to keep selling them in the U.S. market, otherwise it will no longer be allowed to sell there. Trump also criticized Bombardier’s product quality, further heightening trade tensions between the two countries.

In a post on Truth Social on Monday, Trump wrote, “NO MORE SELLING BOMBARDIER IN THE UNITED STATES! Their products aren’t good enough!” He added that if Bombardier wants the U.S. market, “it has to be made here,” and urged the company to stop treating the United States as a “cash cow.”

Trump’s remarks come as the trade dispute between the United States and Canada continues to heat up. Canada is expected on Tuesday (the 8th) to roll out a wave of retaliatory tariffs, and friction between Washington and Ottawa has moved beyond tariff measures to target specific firms and industries.

The White House has not immediately explained how Trump will enforce this measure against Bombardier, nor what legal or administrative steps will be taken to block delivery of Bombardier aircraft already certified by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to U.S. customers. Bombardier’s business jets also meet the requirements of the United States‑Mexico‑Canada Agreement (USMCA), the North American trade framework that Trump championed in his first term.

Aerospace analyst Richard Aboulafia said Trump’s latest threat is unlikely to cause business‑jet customers to cancel Bombardier orders, and it is unclear how the administration could actually prevent these planes from being sold in the U.S. market. He noted that most Bombardier private jets use U.S.-made engines supplied by Honeywell Aerospace (HON‑US) and GE Aerospace (GE‑US), meaning U.S. firms are deeply embedded in Bombardier’s production chain.

The aerospace sector has so far been one of the few areas of Trump’s tariff policy that has not suffered major shocks; cross‑border flows of components and aircraft have not been broadly subject to duties. Data from the Aerospace Industries Association show the U.S. aerospace and defense industry is projected to generate a $109.2 billion trade surplus in 2025, with exports growing 25% year‑over‑year.

Analysts point out that aerospace, like the U.S. auto industry, relies heavily on cross‑border supply chains. After years of integration, the U.S. and Canadian aerospace manufacturing systems share components, engines, wings, maintenance and service networks across the border, so restricting Canadian‑made aircraft from the U.S. market could also affect U.S. firms and suppliers.

Bombardier, headquartered in Montreal, competes with U.S. business‑jet maker Gulfstream Aerospace. It employs about 3,500 people in the United States and works with roughly 2,800 U.S. suppliers, operating several factories and service centers on U.S. soil. The company is currently building its sixth U.S. service center and has already produced wings for its flagship Global 8000 private jet in Texas.

Bombardier also runs a defense business, with a U.S. plant in Kansas that converts Canadian‑built aircraft for special‑mission use. Of the roughly 5,100 Bombardier aircraft in service worldwide, about half are based in the United States, underscoring the market’s importance to the firm.
Bombardier has not yet responded to requests for comment on Trump’s latest statements.

This is not the first time Trump has taken a hard line on Bombardier. In January, he said the United States would revoke certification of Bombardier’s Global Express business jet and threatened a 50% import tariff on all Canada‑built aircraft until Canadian regulators approved a certain number of Gulfstream jets. Neither of those measures was ultimately implemented, and the following month Canada approved several Gulfstream models.

Bombardier’s most recent financial report shows the company is still benefiting from the private‑aviation market and after‑sales service demand. The July quarterly results posted a 6% year‑over‑year revenue increase to $2.15 billion, driven primarily by strong aftermarket service demand.

For Bombardier, the United States is not only a key sales market but also a crucial hub for production and its supply chain. Trump’s latest demand that the firm “make it in America” could force Bombardier to expand its U.S. investment and manufacturing footprint. At the same time, if the U.S. government does restrict imports of Canada‑built aircraft, reconciling that move with existing FAA certifications, the USMCA framework and cross‑border supply‑chain rules will be critical to whether the policy can be implemented.

items.title: 美債是AI泡沫的「終極殺手」？機構：10年期殖利率破5%或成引爆點
paras: 過去300年每次重大泡沫都終結於核心企業借貸成本顯著上升，然而美國本輪債務擴張的核心卻在政府，這項結構性差異可能改變過去「企業去槓桿」主導泡沫破裂的模式，也讓10年期美國公債殖利率是否突破「5%」門檻成為左右人工智慧（AI）熱潮能否延續的重要指標。
洛克菲勒國際（Rockefeller International）董事長 Ruchir Sharma 在《金融時報》撰文指出，美國聯邦政府債務已突破40兆美元，10年期美債殖利率約4.8%。若殖利率進一步「決定性突破5%」，觸及網際網路泡沫時代以來的重要區間上緣，可能成為AI泡沫破裂的導火線。
Sharma 認為，政府以高利率發行大量債券所產生的「擠出效應」，正逐步推高AI企業取得債券及股權融資的成本。
目前AI應用每年營收估計約2000億美元，相較之下，資料中心等相關基礎設施支出已超過1兆美元，兩者之間存在龐大落差，而這項資金缺口高度仰賴外部融資。一旦長天期利率快速攀升，可能直接影響AI產業持續擴大投資的速度。

本輪債務過剩集中政府　AI泡沫結構出現變化

Sharma 回顧過去300年的重大資產泡沫指出，泡沫通常在核心企業的借貸成本大幅上升後走向破裂。從19世紀鐵路泡沫，到現代央行體系下的歷次市場泡沫，都可看到類似模式。
一般而言，市場狂熱期間，企業會大量舉債押注熱門產業或投資題材，隨著通膨及利率攀升，融資成本上升最終刺破泡沫；之後政府才介入，透過承接債務及刺激經濟來穩定市場。
但Sharma認為，這一次的情況有所不同。
自2020年代以來，美國財政赤字持續約占GDP的6%，超過此前數十年的平均水準一倍以上。與此同時，美國家庭及企業長期並未大幅增加槓桿。
直到過去一年，隨著科技巨頭逐漸消耗手中現金盈餘，才開始透過大規模舉債支應龐大的AI基礎建設投資。不過，以這些大型企業的規模而言，目前槓桿水準仍處於可控範圍。
Sharma指出，因此本輪週期真正大幅累積的債務，目前主要集中在政府部門，而風險可能正從負債最嚴重的地方開始浮現。

政府發債產生擠出效應　10年期美債5%成重要關卡

隨著政府債務快速膨脹，美國債券市場的「擠出效應」也開始受到關注。
美國公共債務未償餘額已達40.05兆美元，首次突破40兆美元；本財政年度利息支出達1.17兆美元。與此同時，30年期美債殖利率升至5.32%，創2007年以來新高。
過去5年，美國公共債務利息支出已翻倍至超過GDP的3%，不僅創下美國紀錄，也是主要已開發經濟體中增幅最快、占比最高的國家。
財政壓力與能源價格上漲，進一步推高全球債券殖利率，而無風險利率走高，也會同步增加AI企業的融資成本。AI產業目前正是新發公司債的重要需求來源之一。
Sharma因此將10年期美債殖利率視為關鍵觀察指標。他認為，一旦殖利率「決定性突破5%」，將代表更高利率環境進一步確立，AI大型投資計畫的融資難度也會隨之升高。
當大型科技企業必須與殖利率超過5%、通膨調整後報酬率超過2.5%的政府公債競逐資金時，部分企業可能難以繼續從債券市場取得所需資金。

AI營收遠低於基礎建設支出　融資缺口成市場隱憂

目前AI應用年營收估計僅約2000億美元，遠低於資料中心等基礎設施超過1兆美元的投資規模。AI企業因此愈來愈需要透過新發債券及股票融資填補資金缺口。
然而，10年期美債殖利率若突破5%，可能同時對債券及股票兩大融資管道形成壓力；此外，該殖利率也將高於美股的盈餘殖利率，歷史上通常不利於股市表現。
若10年期美債殖利率在11月前突破5%，代表半年內上升超過75個基點，而歷史上類似幅度的殖利率快速攀升，都曾終結牛市。
儘管部分分析師認為，殖利率突破5%只代表回到1990年代的水準，當時10年期美債殖利率長期高於5%，美股仍維持強勁表現；但Sharma認為，當時美國的債務結構與如今截然不同。
1990年代的美國以財政盈餘結束10年，而目前美國公眾持有的政府債務已接近GDP的100%，償債成本也遠高於當時。因此，公共部門借貸成本上升，可能更迅速擠壓其他借款人，並對估值已大幅擴張的AI市場形成更大壓力。
在此背景下，後續市場將關注10年期美債殖利率是否、以及以多快速度突破5%，以及利率變化可能對AI資本支出與美股估值帶來的衝擊。

items.title: 美債恐比想像更糟 頂尖經濟學家：殖利率已進入「全面應戰」狀態
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Worsens More Than Expected, Top Economist Says Yields Have Entered a “Full‑Scale Battle” State
paras: 美國公債市場近期浮現令人不安的跡象。布魯金斯學會資深研究員布魯克斯（Robin Brooks）指出，殖利率上升顯示，市場情勢可能比表面看來更加嚴峻。
布魯克斯周二在 Substack 發文表示，美國政策目前已將重點放在防止長期借貸成本急升，並提到美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）正努力將公債買回規模提高一倍。
經濟轉弱 殖利率不降反升
他進一步指出，近期反映經濟活動疲弱的數據，並未像過去一樣帶動長期殖利率下滑，凸顯市場本身的上行壓力有多大。
布魯克斯寫道：「就我所見，長期殖利率已進入各方全面應戰的局面。」
儘管上周五公布的就業報告意外優於預期，但布魯克斯表示，過去一個月其他經濟數據大多不如預期。照理說，市場應因經濟放緩及通膨降溫而推低殖利率，但實際上，殖利率卻持續攀升。
不可否認，美國對伊朗的戰事近幾周也持續升溫。隨著衝突加劇，外交談判又未見進展，油價重新走高，使通膨前景更加惡化。
不過，布魯克斯認為，10 年期美債殖利率的異常走勢，其實透露出「市場對美國公債的需求，比表面看來更為疲弱」。
美國債務規模如今已達 40 兆美元，正逐漸超越人工智慧（AI）熱潮，成為華爾街關注焦點。債務疑慮也不僅限於美國，英國、法國、德國及日本等主要經濟體的公債殖利率同樣大幅攀升。
自新冠疫情以來，各國政府持續支出，彷彿借貸成本仍處於危機時期的低點，並任由財政赤字惡化，彷彿經濟仍亟需緊急刺激措施。
然而，如今的經濟環境已截然不同。為抑制高通膨，利率近年大幅攀升；與此同時，AI 熱潮每年為經濟注入數千億美元資金，使經濟對高利率的敏感度愈來愈低。
RSM 首席經濟學家布魯塞拉斯（Joseph Brusuelas）上月在報告中表示：「債務何時會變得不可持續？當全球金融市場這麼認定時。現在看來，這種情況似乎正在發生。」
傳統買家退場 美債波動加劇
同一時間，美債買方結構也已改變。過去為資金尋找安全停泊處的外國央行及其他機構，在美債市場中的角色逐漸縮小，並愈來愈多轉向黃金等替代性避險資產。
全球最大主權財富基金、管理資產達 2.3 兆美元的挪威銀行投資管理公司（Norges Bank Investment Management），已提議調整債券配置，降低對美債的依賴。
隨著傳統美債買家退場，避險基金已成為市場重要參與者，但這類投資人對價格更加敏感，也加劇債市波動。
這意味著，美國財政部必須提供更具吸引力的殖利率，才能讓債券投資人持續進場。在年度預算赤字朝 2 兆美元邁進、國會議員又未展現控制赤字意願之際，市場對於繼續以如此龐大規模借錢給美國聯邦政府，已日益感到不安。
布魯克斯認為，殖利率與經濟數據脫鉤，背後有一個「顯而易見的解釋」，也就是市場更加關注財政赤字前景，因此推升長期利率。
他補充表示：「美債市場的內在動態，比你想像的更令人憂心。」
不過，也有人將殖利率上升解讀為經濟強勁的跡象。華爾街資深策略師亞德尼（Ed Yardeni）不認同債務危機即將爆發的警告，反而認為殖利率只是回歸全球金融危機及新冠疫情前的正常水準；這兩場危機曾開啟超低利率時代。
亞德尼近日在報告中補充，當前美國債務的發展軌跡確實不可持續，但所謂的「債券義警」似乎尚未對此感到憂慮，至少目前還沒有。
亞德尼預測：「美債殖利率仍處於大致符合經濟健康狀況的區間，我們預期 10 年期美債殖利率將維持在 4.00% 至 5.00% 之間。」
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market has recently shown unsettling signs. Robin Brooks, a senior researcher at the Brookings Institution, points out that rising yields indicate the market situation may be tougher than it appears on the surface.

Brooks wrote on Substack on Tuesday that current U.S. policy is focused on preventing a sharp jump in long‑term borrowing costs, and noted that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is working to double the scale of Treasury buybacks.
Economic slowdown: Yields rise instead of falling

He further noted that recent data reflecting weak economic activity have not driven long‑term yields down as they have in the past, highlighting how strong the upward pressure from the market itself is.
Brooks wrote: “From what I see, long‑term yields have entered a situation where all sides are fully engaged in a battle.”

Even though last Friday’s jobs report came out better than expected, Brooks says most other economic data over the past month have missed forecasts. In theory, a slowing economy and cooling inflation should push yields lower, but in reality yields keep climbing.

It cannot be denied that U.S. hostilities with Iran have also been heating up in recent weeks. As the conflict intensifies and diplomatic talks stall, oil prices have risen again, worsening the inflation outlook.
Nevertheless, Brooks believes the anomalous movement of the 10‑year Treasury yield actually reveals that “the market’s demand for U.S. Treasuries is weaker than it appears on the surface.”

U.S. debt now stands at $40 trillion, gradually overtaking the AI boom as Wall Street’s focal point. Debt concerns are not limited to the United States; major economies such as the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Japan are also seeing their sovereign yields climb sharply.

Since the COVID‑19 pandemic, governments worldwide have kept spending, as if borrowing costs remain at crisis‑low levels, allowing fiscal deficits to worsen, as if economies still urgently need stimulus measures.

However, today’s economic environment is entirely different. To curb high inflation, rates have risen sharply in recent years; at the same time, the AI boom injects hundreds of billions of dollars into the economy each year, making the economy less sensitive to high rates.

Joseph Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM, said in a report last month: “When will debt become unsustainable? When the global financial markets collectively decide so. It now appears that this is happening.”
Traditional buyers are exiting, increasing Treasury volatility

At the same time, the structure of Treasury buyers has shifted. Foreign central banks and other institutions that once sought safe havens are shrinking their role in the Treasury market and increasingly turning to alternatives such as gold.
Norges Bank Investment Management, the world’s largest sovereign wealth fund with $2.3 trillion in assets, has proposed adjusting its bond allocation to reduce reliance on U.S. Treasuries.
As traditional Treasury buyers exit, hedge funds have become key market participants, but these investors are more price‑sensitive, amplifying bond‑market volatility.

This means the Treasury Department must offer more attractive yields to keep investors buying. With the annual budget deficit moving toward $2 trillion and Congress showing little willingness to curb the deficit, the market is growing increasingly uneasy about continuing to lend such massive sums to the U.S. federal government.
Brooks says the decoupling of yields from economic data has an “obvious explanation”: the market is focusing more on the fiscal‑deficit outlook, which pushes long‑term rates higher.
He added: “The underlying dynamics of the Treasury market are more concerning than you think.”

However, some interpret the rise in yields as a sign of a strong economy. Wall Street veteran strategist Ed Yardeni disagrees with warnings of an imminent debt crisis, arguing instead that yields are simply returning to pre‑COVID‑19 and pre‑global‑financial‑crisis normal levels, which had ushered in an era of ultra‑low rates.
Yardeni recently added in a report that while the current trajectory of U.S. debt is indeed unsustainable, the so‑called “bond vigilantes” do not yet appear worried about it, at least not for now.
Yardeni predicts: “Treasury yields remain broadly in line with a healthy economy; we expect the 10‑year Treasury yield to stay between 4.00% and 5.00%.”

items.title: 4支科技股進入標普100指數 Nike遭剔除 18年輝煌紀錄告終
items.title_en: Four Tech Stocks Enter S&P 100 Index as Nike Is Removed, Ending an 18-Year Streak
paras: 標普道瓊指數公司宣布，全球運動鞋巨頭 Nike(NKE-US) 將於 9 月 21 日美股開盤前被正式剔除出標普 100 指數，結束其將近 18 年的輝煌紀錄。儘管 Nike 仍將保留在更廣泛的標普 500 指數中，但這項重大調整，也象徵著其市場主導地位已面臨根本性的動搖。
在此次季度調整中，高露潔(CL-US)、Simon 地產集團(SPG-US)和Honeywell航太(HONA-US)也將退出標普 100 指數，空缺則由戴爾(DELL-US)、Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US)、Arista Networks (ANET-US) 及 SanDisk (SNDK-US)等4家科技與 AI 基礎設施公司接替，反映出指數向科技業傾斜的趨勢。
Nike 股價在 9 月 4 日跌至 38.40 美元，創下近 12 年來新低，相較於 2021 年底的紀錄高點已慘跌約 78% 至 79%。這場長達5年的衰退，使其市值慘重蒸發超過 2,200 億美元，目前市值僅剩約 570 億美元。其 2026 財年營收為 464 億美元，表現近乎停滯，而被寄予厚望的 Nike Direct 直營業務與數位營收則分別下滑 6% 與 12%。
分析指出，Nike 的困境在於其過度激進的直營(DTC)戰略。此舉削減了與批發通路(如 Foot Locker 等)的合作夥伴關係，大幅減少與新消費者的觸點。同時，Nike 產品創新力不足，過度依賴經典鞋款(如 Air Force 1、AJ1)的換色重刻，加上通路為清庫存而進行折扣戰，嚴重蠶食了品牌的溢價空間。
在關鍵的大中華市場，Nike 2026 財年營收按本幣計算重挫 11% 至 13%，除了安踏、李寧等中國本土品牌崛起搶占份額外，On 和 Hoka 等新興高性能跑鞋品牌也正在全球快速蠶食其份額。
儘管現任執行長 Elliott Hill 承諾推動全面改革，著手重建零售商關係並控制庫存，但市場分析師認為其營收復甦及創新成效仍顯緩慢。
paras_en: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that global sneaker giant Nike (NKE-US) will be formally removed from the S&P 100 index before the market opens on September 21, ending its nearly 18‑year run. Nike will remain in the broader S&P 500, but the move signals a fundamental shake‑up of its market dominance.

In this quarterly reshuffle, Colgate (CL-US), Simon Property Group (SPG-US) and Honeywell Aerospace (HONA-US) will also exit the S&P 100, making way for four technology and AI‑infrastructure firms – Dell (DELL-US), Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US), Arista Networks (ANET-US) and SanDisk (SNDK-US) – reflecting the index’s tilt toward tech.

Nike’s share price fell to $38.40 on September 4, a 12‑year low, roughly a 78‑79% drop from its record high at the end of 2021. The five‑year decline has erased more than $220 billion of market value, leaving a market cap of about $57 billion. Fiscal 2026 revenue was $46.4 billion, essentially flat, while the much‑hyped Nike Direct business and digital sales fell 6% and 12% respectively.

Analysts say Nike’s woes stem from an overly aggressive direct‑to‑consumer (DTC) strategy that has strained relationships with wholesale partners such as Foot Locker, cutting off many consumer touchpoints. In addition, product innovation has lagged, with the brand leaning heavily on color‑way refreshes of classics like the Air Force 1 and AJ1, while discounting to clear inventory has eroded its pricing power.

In the crucial Greater China market, Nike’s fiscal 2026 revenue in local currency fell 11%‑13% as domestic rivals Anta and Li‑Ning gained share and emerging performance‑running brands such as On and Hoka rapidly ate into its market globally.

Although current CEO Elliott Hill has pledged a sweeping reform, rebuilding retailer relationships and tightening inventory, market analysts say revenue recovery and innovation progress remain sluggish.

items.title: 全球首發！獲小米18 Fold頂配版本採用　長鑫LPDDR6實現旗艦手機端商用
items.title_en: World First! Xiaomi 18 Fold Top‑End Version Uses ChangXin LPDDR6, Marking the First Commercial Use of LPDDR6 in Flagship Phones
paras: 小米周一(7日)發布首款「中摺疊」手機小米18 Fold，要價人民幣10999元起跳，頂配版本搭載長鑫LPDDR6記憶體，這是全球LPDDR6產品首次在旗艦手機端落地商用。
規格上，該晶片遵循JEDEC LPDDR6標準，單顆粒容量16Gb、封裝容量16GB，採用1295 Ball FBGA封裝，最高傳輸速率達12800Mbps，與SoC搭配速率10667Mbps。相較LPDDR5X，LPDDR6頻寬提升60%、功耗降低20%，可為SoC提供充裕資料頻寬並延長續航。
上述數據源自內部測試，頻寬提升部分基於峰值對比。
技術面，LPDDR6採雙子通道架構，配置24bit原生I/O，高速介面支援每路訊號引腳獨立調校預加重與DFE參數，搭配智慧訓練機制確保傳輸穩定；能效導入雙軌DVFS與動態效率模式，兼顧高算力與長續航。
可靠性方面，除既有Link ECC、On Die ECC外，新增每行激活計數(PRAC)防範行錘攻擊，以及內建自測試(MBIST)等機制。
製程方面，針對CMOS關鍵電路與設計規則LDR進行逾百項優化，打造更小更優的電晶體；封裝因焊球面積較LPDDR5的496 Ball大50%，難度同步提升，長鑫改以高導熱型High K EMC塑封，使顆粒熱阻降約40%，強化高負載散熱。
長鑫存儲強調，LPDDR6成功推出是該公司高端存儲自主研發的重要里程碑，產品正加速商業化與規模化應用。
paras_en: Xiaomi on Monday (the 7th) launched its first "mid‑fold" smartphone, the Xiaomi 18 Fold, starting at RMB 10,999. The top‑end version is equipped with ChangXin LPDDR6 memory, representing the world’s first commercial deployment of an LPDDR6 product in a flagship handset.

In terms of specifications, the chip follows the JEDEC LPDDR6 standard, with a single‑die capacity of 16 Gb and a package capacity of 16 GB, using a 1295‑ball FBGA package. It achieves a maximum transfer rate of 12,800 Mbps, and when paired with the SoC the effective rate is 10,667 Mbps. Compared with LPDDR5X, LPDDR6 offers a 60 % bandwidth increase and a 20 % power‑consumption reduction, providing ample data bandwidth for the SoC while extending battery life.
These figures come from internal testing, and the bandwidth gain is based on peak‑to‑peak comparisons.

Technically, LPDDR6 uses a twin‑channel architecture with native 24‑bit I/O. Its high‑speed interface supports independent pre‑emphasis and DFE tuning for each signal pin, combined with an intelligent training mechanism to ensure stable transmission; power efficiency is achieved through dual‑track DVFS and dynamic efficiency modes, balancing high compute performance with long endurance.

In terms of reliability, in addition to existing Link ECC and On‑Die ECC, a per‑row activation count (PRAC) feature is added to guard against row‑hammer attacks, along with built‑in self‑test (MBIST) mechanisms.

Regarding process technology, more than a hundred optimizations were made to CMOS critical circuits and LDR design rules to create smaller, better transistors; the package’s solder‑ball area is 50 % larger than the 496‑ball LPDDR5, raising integration difficulty, so ChangXin switched to a high‑thermal‑conductivity High‑K EMC molding that reduces the die’s thermal resistance by about 40 %, improving heat dissipation under heavy load.

ChangXin Storage emphasizes that the successful launch of LPDDR6 is a major milestone in the company’s high‑end memory self‑development roadmap, and the product is now accelerating toward commercial and large‑scale deployment.

items.title: 川普再發聲安撫選民：戰勝伊朗後油價將「斷崖式下跌」　最終跌至每加侖2美元以下
items.title_en: Trump Says Oil Prices Will Plummet Below $2 per Gallon After Defeating Iran
paras: 美國總統川普周一(7日)在Truth Social上發表強硬言論，對於正在進行的美伊衝突以及全球能源市場前景做出高調預測。
川普在貼文中表示，在美國贏得與伊朗的戰爭後，全球油價及全美零售汽油價格將迎來「斷崖式下跌」，最終甚至會跌破每加侖2美元關口。「當我們贏得與伊朗的戰爭時，油價將會斷崖式下跌，就像其他所有東西都在下跌一樣(但跌得更多！)。油價將先降到每加侖3美元，最終會跌到2美元以下。這一切都將迅速發生，而且伊朗永遠不會擁有核武器。MAGA！」
這並非川普首次將中東軍事衝突與美國國內民生經濟直接掛鉤。自今年初美伊爆發衝突、荷姆茲海峽這一關鍵航道受阻以來，全球能源市場劇烈震盪，全美零售汽油均價一度飆升，近期也在高點徘徊，部分地區甚至出現創紀錄的燃料成本，這讓全美消費者和企業主背負沉重的通膨壓力。
面對美國國內對高油價的廣泛怨氣，川普醉心表態顯然意在安撫選民，試圖將當前的經濟陣痛塑造為實現長期安全與「能源紅利」的必要代價。
此前，川普曾表示，為了徹底消除德黑蘭的核威脅，短期內的能源價格上漲對美國和世界和平而言是「微不足道的代價」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a hard‑line statement on Truth Social on Monday (the 7th), offering bold predictions about the ongoing U.S.–Iran clash and the outlook for global energy markets.

In the post, Trump claimed that once the United States wins its war with Iran, global oil prices and U.S. retail gasoline prices will experience a “cliff‑drop,” eventually falling below the $2‑per‑gallon threshold. He said, “When we win the war with Iran, oil prices will plunge like everything else is falling (but even more!). Oil will first drop to $3 a gallon and eventually go under $2. All of this will happen quickly, and Iran will never have a nuclear weapon. MAGA!”

This is not the first time Trump has directly linked Middle‑East military conflict to the domestic U.S. economy. Since the U.S.–Iran confrontation erupted earlier this year and the critical Hormuz Strait was blocked, global energy markets have been wildly volatile, U.S. retail gasoline prices surged and have been hovering near recent highs, with some regions seeing record‑breaking fuel costs that have weighed heavily on American consumers and business owners amid inflation pressures.

Facing widespread domestic anger over high fuel prices, Trump’s fervent statements appear aimed at soothing voters, trying to frame the current economic pain as a necessary cost for long‑term security and an “energy dividend.”
Previously, Trump said that to fully eliminate Tehran’s nuclear threat, the short‑term rise in energy prices is a “trivial cost” for U.S. and world peace.

items.title: 美伊可能沒有核協議？美能源部長：考慮直接摧毀伊朗核能力
items.title_en: U.S. Energy Secretary Says Direct Destruction of Iran's Nuclear Capability May Be Considered If No Deal
paras: 美國與伊朗衝突進入第7個月之際，美國能源部長萊特（Chris Wright）週日（6日）表示，美國未必能與伊朗達成限制其取得核武能力的協議，若外交談判無法取得成果，美方可能直接採取摧毀伊朗核能力的方式，以阻止德黑蘭發展核武。
根據《CNBC》報導，萊特接受《ABC 》This Week節目訪問時表示：「可能不會有核協議。可能只是摧毀他們發展核武的能力。」
他說：「協議可能要等到伊朗下一屆政府上台後才有機會達成。我們確實不知道。」
美國總統川普一再強調，阻止伊朗取得核武是美方軍事行動的核心目標之一；與此同時，川普在戰事持續期間也一直尋求與伊朗透過談判達成協議。
不過，萊特的最新說法顯示，川普政府可能在無法達成外交協議的情況下，仍透過軍事手段持續削弱伊朗的核武發展能力。
當被問及若伊朗試圖重建核設施，美國是否會繼續發動攻擊時，萊特表示，關鍵在於摧毀伊朗發展核武的能力。
他說：「我們正在削弱他們發展核武的能力，以及如果他們真的研發出核武，最終將其運送出去的能力。這是一項持續了47年的努力。這並非小事，但美國將完成這項任務，我們也會與該地區的盟友合作。」
不過，萊特稍後接受《CBS》Face the Nation訪問時強調，川普仍然偏好透過談判解決問題，除非軍事手段「絕對必要」，否則不希望採取軍事解決方案。
他並表示，目前美軍在中東地區最重要的任務之一，是阻止伊朗原油、相關石油產品及天然氣出口，藉此對伊朗經濟施加壓力，迫使現任政權改變政策，或促成政權更替。

伊朗警告將採取「更快、更嚴厲、更痛苦」反擊

面對美方持續施壓，伊朗國會議長兼首席談判代表卡利巴夫（Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf）週日表示，伊朗針對美國攻擊所採取的「對等反應」已經結束，同時承認戰爭正對伊朗經濟造成衝擊。
卡利巴夫在Telegram發文表示：「如果他們到現在還沒有理解，就應該在為時已晚之前明白，遊戲規則已經改變。從現在開始，任何侵犯伊朗利益與安全的行為，都將遭到「更快、更嚴厲、更痛苦』的回應。」
不過，他同時承認，持續的軍事衝突已對伊朗經濟造成嚴重壓力，包括匯率劇烈波動、通膨、失業以及市場管理等問題，都正對民眾生計造成重大衝擊。
卡利巴夫同時強調，伊朗有必要更加依賴國內生產，並運用科技來「制定短期及永久性的解決方案」。
他的談話發布前，美軍才剛攻擊3艘伊朗原油運輸船。美國中央司令部（CENTCOM）表示，其中1艘油輪在哈爾克島（Kharg Island）外海遭到攻擊後永久失去運作能力，另一艘則在賈斯克（Jask）附近遭到攻擊，第3艘油輪則在阿曼灣遭襲。
伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷扎伊（Mohsen Rezaei）週日則表示，德黑蘭計畫宣布在荷姆茲海峽以外設立新的限制區域，範圍將涵蓋波斯灣部分海域。
CENTCOM表示，美軍對油輪發動攻擊，是為報復伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊（IRGC）先前向當地兩艘美國軍艦發射彈道飛彈。美方稱，一艘美國航空母艦及一艘神盾級驅逐艦成功躲避多次攻擊，沒有美軍人員受傷。
CENTCOM司令庫柏（Brad Cooper）表示，若伊朗向美軍艦艇開火，美方將讓伊朗付出更高的經濟代價，並警告不排除摧毀伊朗有限且暴露在外的石油船隊。
美國國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）隨後也在X發文表示，若伊朗攻擊美國海軍艦艇，美軍就會摧毀並擊沉伊朗油輪。

美國加強制裁　伊朗經濟壓力持續升高

伊朗是石油輸出國組織（OPEC）第3大產油國，戰爭爆發前，約90%的原油出口都經由哈爾克島。自4月中旬美國開始封鎖伊朗石油出口後，相關石油流動受到嚴重干擾。
美伊衝突也使荷姆茲海峽這條全球重要石油運輸通道幾乎陷入停擺。
川普6月曾威脅要奪取哈爾克島，並持續對伊朗發動軍事攻擊。最新一次是在8月31日，他於社群平台發布一段由AI生成、呈現哈爾克島遭摧毀的影片。
除了軍事行動，美國也持續加碼經濟制裁。美國財政部日前宣布制裁一家土耳其小型投資銀行及旗下兩家子公司，指控這些機構協助伊朗革命衛隊相關組織取得資金。
這些措施是川普政府8月底啟動的新一輪制裁的一部分，目標涵蓋伊朗取得數位資產、先進科技、黃金儲備、商業航空及航運等領域的能力。
伊朗總統裴澤斯基安（Masoud Pezeshkian）上月底表示，伊朗貿易規模已大幅下滑。
世界銀行估計，截至3月的一年期間，伊朗國內生產毛額（GDP）萎縮2.7%，主要受到前一年大規模抗議活動造成的經濟干擾，以及區域衝突升溫影響。
此外，伊朗2月通膨率升至62.2%，食品價格通膨更達99%，創下歷史新高。
根據《紐約時報》引述伊朗官員說法，這場戰爭已造成伊朗約100萬個工作機會流失。
paras_en: As the U.S.-Iran conflict enters its seventh month, U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said on Sunday (the 6th) that the United States may not be able to reach an agreement to limit Iran’s acquisition of nuclear weapons capability, and if diplomatic talks fail, the U.S. could directly destroy Iran’s nuclear capability to prevent Tehran from developing a nuclear weapon.
Wright told ABC’s This Week, as reported by CNBC, “There may not be a nuclear deal. It may just be about destroying their ability to develop nuclear weapons.”
He added, “A deal might only be possible after Iran’s next administration comes to power. We really don’t know.”

President Trump has repeatedly emphasized that preventing Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons is a core objective of U.S. military action; at the same time, he has continued to seek a negotiated settlement with Iran throughout the ongoing hostilities.

However, Wright’s latest remarks suggest that the Trump administration could continue to weaken Iran’s nuclear weapons development capacity by military means if a diplomatic agreement cannot be reached.
When asked whether the United States would keep striking if Iran tried to rebuild nuclear facilities, Wright said the key is to destroy Iran’s ability to develop nuclear weapons.

He said, “We are degrading their ability to develop nuclear weapons, and if they actually develop a nuclear weapon, their ability to eventually deliver it. This has been a 47‑year effort. It’s not a small thing, but the United States will complete this mission and we will work with regional allies.”
Wright later told CBS’s Face the Nation that Trump still prefers to resolve the issue through negotiations and would not pursue a military solution unless it is “absolutely necessary.”

He also said that one of the most important U.S. missions in the Middle East right now is to block Iran’s crude oil, related petroleum products, and natural gas exports, using economic pressure to force the current regime to change policy or to enable a regime change.

Iran warned it will respond “faster, harsher, more painful” to U.S. pressure. In response to continued U.S. pressure, Iranian Parliament Speaker and chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said on Sunday that Iran’s “reciprocal response” to U.S. attacks has ended, while acknowledging that the war is hurting Iran’s economy.

Ghalibaf posted on Telegram, “If they still don’t understand by now, they should realize before it’s too late that the rules of the game have changed. From now on, any act that infringes on Iran’s interests and security will be met with a ‘faster, harsher, more painful’ response.”

He also admitted that the ongoing military conflict is placing severe pressure on Iran’s economy, including sharp currency fluctuations, inflation, unemployment and market‑management problems that are hitting citizens’ livelihoods.
Ghalibaf stressed that Iran needs to rely more on domestic production and use technology to “craft short‑term and permanent solutions.”

Just before his remarks, U.S. forces had attacked three Iranian crude‑oil tankers. CENTCOM said one tanker was permanently disabled after being hit off Kharg Island, another was hit near Jask, and a third was attacked in the Gulf of Oman.
Iran’s Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei said on Sunday that Tehran plans to announce a new restricted zone outside the Hormuz Strait that will cover part of the Persian Gulf.

CENTCOM said the attacks on the tankers were retaliation for a prior ballistic‑missile launch by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps at two U.S. warships in the area. The U.S. said an aircraft carrier and a guided‑missile destroyer evaded multiple attacks with no U.S. personnel injured.

CENTCOM commander Brad Cooper warned that if Iran fires on U.S. vessels, the United States will make Iran pay a higher economic price and did not rule out destroying Iran’s limited and exposed oil fleet.
U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth later posted on X that if Iran attacks U.S. Navy ships, the U.S. will destroy and sink Iranian tankers.

U.S. sanctions intensify, raising economic pressure on Iran. Iran is the world’s third‑largest OPEC oil producer, and before the war about 90% of its crude exports passed through Kharg Island. Since the U.S. began blocking Iranian oil exports in mid‑April, oil flows have been severely disrupted.
The U.S.-Iran clash has also nearly halted traffic through the Hormuz Strait, a globally critical oil‑shipping lane.

In June, Trump threatened to seize Kharg Island and continued military strikes against Iran. The latest instance was on August 31, when he posted an AI‑generated video depicting the island’s destruction on social media.

Beyond military actions, the United States is also tightening economic sanctions. The Treasury recently sanctioned a small Turkish investment bank and two of its subsidiaries, accusing them of helping IRGC‑linked entities obtain funding.

These measures are part of a new round of sanctions launched by the Trump administration at the end of August, targeting Iran’s ability to acquire digital assets, advanced technology, gold reserves, commercial aviation and shipping capabilities.
Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian said at the end of last month that Iran’s trade volume has sharply declined.

The World Bank estimates that Iran’s GDP contracted by 2.7% over the 12‑month period ending March, mainly due to the economic disruption from massive protests the previous year and the escalation of regional conflict.
In addition, Iran’s February inflation rate rose to 62.2%, with food price inflation reaching 99%, a historic high.
According to the New York Times citing Iranian officials, the war has cost Iran roughly one million jobs.

items.title: HBM需求從GPU擴大至ASIC 高容量堆疊帶動先進封裝升級
items.title_en: HBM Demand Expands from GPUs to ASICs; High‑Capacity Stacks Drive Advanced Packaging Upgrades
paras: 2026年09月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI晶片市場由GPU向客製化ASIC擴散，並未改變HBM需求成長方向。相反地，AI晶片平台增加、單顆晶片搭載的HBM容量提高，正讓HBM需求從單純追蹤GPU出貨量，轉向同時觀察ASIC採用率、堆疊數量與單一堆疊容量。
市調機構SNS Insider估計，GPU占2025年HBM市場58%，仍是最大處理器應用，但AI加速器與ASIC將成為成長最快的類別。Google、Amazon、Microsoft及Meta持續發展自有AI晶片，代表HBM客戶結構可能由少數GPU平台，擴大至更多客製化加速器。
不過，ASIC成長不能直接等同HBM產值同步增加。不同晶片採用的HBM顆數、容量、頻寬及產品世代並不相同，部分推論型晶片也可能以較低記憶體規格換取成本與功耗效率。因此，後續需要觀察的不是ASIC出貨量本身，而是每款晶片的HBM搭載價值。
產品規格也在向高容量移動。16GB堆疊占2025年市場36%，仍是最大容量級距，但24GB以上產品成長最快。這代表未來HBM位元需求可能同時受三個變數推動，包括AI加速器出貨增加、每顆晶片配置更多HBM，以及單一堆疊容量提高。
HBM容量與堆疊數增加，也會擴大先進封裝需求。HBM是將多層DRAM垂直堆疊的高頻寬記憶體，必須透過矽中介層與邏輯晶片整合，才能縮短資料傳輸距離。台積電(2330-TW)的CoWoS便是相關2.5D封裝平台之一。
台積電規劃2027年量產9.5倍光罩尺寸CoWoS，可在單一封裝內整合12顆以上HBM，較大的封裝面積將支援更高運算能力與記憶體頻寬。這使HBM成長效益不只落在SK海力士(000660-KR)、三星電子(005930-KR)及美光(MU-US)，也可能延伸至台積電、日月光投控(3711-TW)及封裝材料與設備供應鏈。

paras_en: September 8, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The AI chip market is spreading from GPUs to custom ASICs, but this does not change the growth direction of HBM demand. On the contrary, the increase in AI chip platforms and the larger HBM capacity per chip are shifting HBM demand from simply tracking GPU shipments to also monitoring ASIC adoption rates, stack counts, and per‑stack capacity.

Research firm SNS Insider estimates that GPUs will account for 58% of the HBM market in 2025, remaining the largest processor application, while AI accelerators and ASICs will become the fastest‑growing categories. Google, Amazon, Microsoft and Meta continue to develop their own AI chips, indicating that the HBM customer base may expand from a few GPU platforms to many custom accelerators.

However, ASIC growth cannot be directly equated with a proportional increase in HBM revenue. Different chips use varying numbers of HBM dies, capacities, bandwidths and product generations, and some inference chips may opt for lower‑spec memory to save cost and power. Therefore, the focus should be on the HBM value per chip rather than ASIC shipment volumes alone.

Product specifications are also moving toward higher capacity. 16‑GB stacks will represent 36% of the 2025 market, still the largest capacity tier, but products above 24 GB are growing the fastest. This means future HBM bit demand could be driven by three variables: more AI accelerator shipments, more HBM per chip, and larger per‑stack capacity.

The increase in HBM capacity and stack count will also expand demand for advanced packaging. HBM is a high‑bandwidth memory that vertically stacks multiple DRAM layers and must be integrated with the logic chip via a silicon interposer to shorten data‑transfer distances. TSMC’s (2330‑TW) CoWoS is one such 2.5D packaging platform.

TSMC plans to mass‑produce a 9.5‑times‑larger mask‑size CoWoS in 2027, capable of integrating more than 12 HBM stacks in a single package. The larger package area will support higher compute power and memory bandwidth. This growth benefit for HBM could extend beyond SK Hynix (000660‑KR), Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR) and Micron (MU‑US) to also include TSMC, ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) and the broader packaging material and equipment supply chain.

items.title: 短缺惡化 ！韓券商：三星、SK海力士記憶體庫存量不足10天
items.title_en: Shortage Worsens! Korean Brokers: Samsung and SK Hynix Memory Inventories Below 10 Days
paras: 記憶體短缺惡化 韓兩大廠庫存不到10天
南韓券商KB Securities周一(7日)出具最新研究報告警告，記憶體半導體短缺狀況似乎還在惡化：三星電子與SK海力士的記憶體庫存已降至不足10天的供應量，明年可用供給將明顯不足。
報告指出，隨著AI基礎設施投資以空前速度擴張，記憶體晶片市場面臨嚴重供給短缺，而加劇短缺的關鍵因素，在於向下一代高頻寬記憶體HBM4過渡。HBM4所需晶圓約為傳統DRAM的三倍，在晶圓產能有限下，HBM4全面量產勢必排擠傳統DRAM產能。
該券商預估，2027年DRAM與NAND需求將因此超出供給10個百分點以上。研究主管Kim Dong-won強調，AI伺服器不僅消耗HBM，也消耗伺服器DDR5記憶體與企業級固態硬碟，恐導致歷史性短缺。
此外，全球超大規模資料中心業者已將明年AI基礎設施投資預期上調至1.3兆美元，年增60%。
KB Securities預估，2027年記憶體將占AI基礎設施總投資的57%，遠高於去年的14%，TrendForce則估計可能高達68%。
儘管市場供不應求，三星電子與SK海力士股價近來卻大幅回檔，分別較高點下跌近28%與40%，因記憶體股廣泛修正及韓股槓桿率過高。
分析師認為，相較於基本面，三星電子與SK海力士股票遭嚴重低估，預期獲利將連三年創下歷史新高。
KB Securities指出，在市場預期大規模股東回報政策延續下，當前時期可能象徵半導體產業估值大幅提升的開端。
paras_en: Memory shortage worsens as inventories at South Korea's two biggest manufacturers fall below ten days

South Korean brokerage KB Securities issued a research note on Monday (the 7th) warning that the memory semiconductor shortage appears to be worsening: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix now have less than ten days of supply on hand, and next year available supply will be clearly insufficient.

The report says that as AI infrastructure investment expands at an unprecedented pace, the memory chip market faces a severe supply crunch, and the key factor deepening the shortage is the transition to the next‑generation high‑bandwidth memory HBM4. HBM4 requires about three times as many wafers as traditional DRAM, so limited wafer capacity and full‑scale HBM4 production will inevitably crowd out conventional DRAM capacity.

The brokerage estimates that by 2027 DRAM and NAND demand will exceed supply by more than ten percentage points. Research head Kim Dong‑won stressed that AI servers consume not only HBM but also server DDR5 memory and enterprise‑grade solid‑state drives, potentially creating a historic shortage.
In addition, the world’s largest hyperscale data‑center operators have raised their AI infrastructure investment outlook for next year to $1.3 trillion, a 60% year‑over‑year increase.
KB Securities projects that memory will account for 57% of total AI infrastructure spending in 2027, far above last year’s 14%, while TrendForce estimates the share could reach as high as 68%.

Despite the supply‑demand imbalance, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares have recently pulled back sharply, falling about 28% and 40% from recent highs, due to a broad correction in memory stocks and overly high leverage in the Korean market.
Analysts argue that, relative to fundamentals, Samsung and SK Hynix stocks are severely undervalued and earnings are expected to hit historic highs for three consecutive years.

KB Securities notes that, given market expectations of continued large‑scale shareholder return policies, the current period may mark the beginning of a substantial uplift in semiconductor industry valuations.

items.title: 美國期中選舉恐成AI投資「新瓶頸」！大摩密切關注「這幾場」選戰
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections May Become New Bottleneck for AI Investment, Morgan Stanley Watches "These" Races Closely
paras: 全球科技巨頭為推動人工智慧（AI）發展，持續砸下鉅資興建資料中心，但隨著大型設施陸續進入地方社區，反對聲浪也逐漸升溫，部分計畫甚至因此延宕或取消。摩根士丹利近期警告，資料中心引發的地方反彈，可能成為AI投資熱潮面臨的新瓶頸。
根據《Business Insider》報導，摩根士丹利上週發布報告指出，該行正密切關注今年11月美國多場選舉，因相關選舉結果可能對未來資料中心建設產生影響。
摩根士丹利策略師Ariana Salvatore表示，自去年秋季相關議題開始浮現以來，該行便將其視為2026年選舉的重要切入點。不過，目前來看，資料中心政策風險仍主要集中在州與地方層級，尚未成為聯邦層面的主要問題。
隨著市場對AI交易的熱度持續升高，資料中心遭地方反對也逐漸受到金融業界關注。摩根士丹利近期已將地方反彈列為AI交易可能面臨的瓶頸之一，越來越多金融業人士開始將資料中心反彈視為AI投資題材的潛在風險。
美國總統川普也已介入這項爭議。他曾在Truth Social發文支持資料中心建設，認為大型資料中心能帶來經濟效益，並為美國鄉村地區創造利益。
不過，資料中心規模龐大，對部分經濟條件本就不佳的地區而言，也可能帶來沉重成本及重要資源消耗，使地方政府與居民對相關建設更加警戒。

摩根士丹利盯緊多場選舉　資料中心政策成競選議題

摩根士丹利認為，資料中心對AI交易的風險可能在2028年總統大選後進一步升高，但在此之前，該行已鎖定多場今年期中選舉相關競爭，因選舉結果可能影響部分已規劃中的資料中心計畫。
在眾議院選舉方面，摩根士丹利關注賓州第8選區共和黨Rob Bresnahan Jr.與民主黨Paige Cognetti的競爭。
Bresnahan今年6月提出法案，希望提高科技企業因地方分區及土地使用問題起訴社區的難度。其《地方控制保護法》（Local Control Protection Act）將限制資料中心開發商對反對相關建設的地方政府提起訴訟，但目前尚無共同提案人，法案也尚未離開委員會。
Cognetti則將資料中心議題納入競選訴求，但目前尚未提出相應的具體機制。
另一場受到關注的是密西根州第7選區，共和黨Tom Barrett對上民主黨William Lawrence。Lawrence支持資料中心暫停建設，Barrett則已提出多項法案，試圖限制資料中心可能造成的過度影響。
Lawrence支持由Bernie Sanders與Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez提出的《AI資料中心暫停法》（AI Data Center Moratorium Act），主張聯邦層級暫停資料中心建設。
Barrett則在8月20日提出《資料中心地方控制保護法》（Protecting Local Control of Data Centers Act）及《禁止資料中心保密協議法》（No Data Centers NDAs Act），相關措施均須透過聯邦立法才能實施。

參議院選戰升溫　德州、密西根成關注焦點

參議院方面，摩根士丹利將德州選戰列為觀察重點，由共和黨Ken Paxton對決民主黨James Talarico。
Talarico已將資料中心監管列為競選核心議題之一，並提出「資料中心問責計畫」（Hold Data Centers Accountable Plan），內容包括取消州銷售稅優惠、設定聯邦最低標準，以及要求資料中心採用封閉循環用水系統。
Paxton過去對資料中心相關議題反應較慢，但近期也提出降低資料中心負面影響的方案，包括支持取消相關稅務優惠、限制資料中心在鄉村地區選址，以及禁止中國科技。
密西根州則由共和黨Mike Rogers對決民主黨Abdul El-Sayed。Rogers在8月20日表態支持密西根州暫停資料中心建設1年，但強調並不支持聯邦層級全面禁止。
El-Sayed則對資料中心持較強烈批評態度，主張建立更嚴格的監管與分區制度，包括全面性的土地使用規範、地方否決權，以及要求資料中心與社區達成利益回饋協議。
不過，摩根士丹利指出，兩名候選人均無法單獨透過選舉結果直接實施密西根州的資料中心暫停措施。
俄亥俄州參議院選戰同樣受到關注，共和黨Jon Husted對上民主黨Sherrod Brown。
摩根士丹利表示，目前兩名候選人都沒有明確支持暫停資料中心建設。Husted認為資料中心選址屬於地方政府權限，而Brown則將矛頭指向資料中心相關稅務優惠。
Brown更曾將Husted形容為俄亥俄州資料中心議題的「代表人物」，但目前雙方都未明確主張暫停相關建設。
paras_en: Global tech giants continue to pour massive funds into building data centers to advance artificial intelligence (AI), but as large facilities enter local communities, opposition is growing, causing some projects to be delayed or cancelled. Morgan Stanley recently warned that local backlash against data centers could become a new bottleneck for the AI investment boom.

According to Business Insider, Morgan Stanley released a report last week noting that the firm is closely monitoring several U.S. elections in November, as the outcomes could affect future data‑center construction.

Morgan Stanley strategist Ariana Salvatore said that since the issue first surfaced in the fall of last year, the firm has treated it as a key angle for the 2026 election. However, for now the policy risk around data centers remains largely at the state and local level and has not yet become a major federal issue.

As market enthusiasm for AI trading rises, local opposition to data centers is drawing increasing attention from the financial sector. Morgan Stanley has recently listed local backlash as one of the potential bottlenecks for AI trading, and more finance professionals are viewing data‑center resistance as a possible risk to AI‑investment themes.

Former President Donald Trump has also weighed in on the controversy. He posted on Truth Social in support of data‑center construction, arguing that large facilities bring economic benefits and create value for rural America.

Nevertheless, data centers are massive projects that can impose heavy costs and significant resource consumption on regions already struggling economically, prompting local governments and residents to be more cautious about such developments.

Morgan Stanley sees data‑center policy risks potentially rising after the 2028 presidential election, but before then the firm has identified several midterm contests that could influence planned data‑center projects.
In the House races, Morgan Stanley is watching the contest in Pennsylvania’s 8th district between Republican Rob Bresnahan Jr. and Democrat Paige Cognetti.

Bresnahan introduced a bill in June aimed at making it harder for tech companies to sue communities over zoning and land‑use issues. His Local Control Protection Act would limit data‑center developers from suing local governments that oppose projects, but the bill currently has no co‑sponsor and has not left committee.
Cognetti has incorporated the data‑center issue into her campaign platform, though she has not yet proposed a concrete mechanism.

Another race under scrutiny is Michigan’s 7th district, where Republican Tom Barrett faces Democrat William Lawrence. Lawrence backs a pause on data‑center construction, while Barrett has introduced multiple bills seeking to curb the potential over‑impact of data centers.
Lawrence supports the AI Data Center Moratorium Act introduced by Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio‑Cortez, which calls for a federal‑level pause on data‑center builds.
Barrett on August 20 introduced the Protecting Local Control of Data Centers Act and the No Data Centers NDAs Act; both measures would require federal legislation to take effect.
In the Senate, Morgan Stanley is focusing on Texas, where Republican Ken Paxton squares off against Democrat James Talarico.

Talarico has made data‑center regulation a core campaign issue and proposed a Hold Data Centers Accountable Plan that would eliminate state sales‑tax breaks, set federal minimum standards, and require data centers to use closed‑loop water‑recycling systems.

Paxton has historically been slower on data‑center issues, but recently offered proposals to reduce negative impacts, including ending tax incentives, restricting rural siting, and banning Chinese technology firms.

In Michigan, Republican Mike Rogers faces Democrat Abdul El‑Sayed. Rogers announced on August 20 his support for a one‑year state‑level pause on data‑center construction, while emphasizing he does not back a full federal ban.

El‑Sayed takes a stronger stance against data centers, advocating stricter regulation and zoning, comprehensive land‑use rules, local veto rights, and requiring data‑center operators to negotiate community benefit agreements.
Morgan Stanley notes that neither candidate could unilaterally implement a Michigan data‑center pause through election results alone.
Ohio’s Senate race also draws attention, with Republican Jon Husted against Democrat Sherrod Brown.

Morgan Stanley says neither candidate has explicitly supported pausing data‑center construction. Husted views site selection as a local‑government matter, while Brown points criticism at data‑center tax incentives.
Brown has even called Husted the “figurehead” of Ohio’s data‑center issue, but both sides have yet to formally advocate halting related projects.

items.title: 先進封裝擴產不等於獲利到手中國封測廠進入量產分化期
items.title_en: Advanced Packaging Expansion Does Not Equal Immediate Profit; Chinese Test‑fab Plants Enter a Divergent Mass‑Production Phase
paras: 2026年09月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI與高效能運算需求帶動中國封測廠上半年營收及獲利普遍成長，但從各家公司揭露的進度來看，先進封裝競爭已由技術布局與設備投資，進入客戶驗證、良率提升及量產階段。後續能否轉化為獲利，取決於新產品何時通過認證、產能利用率能否拉高，以及增加的毛利能否覆蓋折舊與固定成本。
統計顯示，中國21家先進封裝指數成分公司中，上半年有20家營收年增、18家歸屬母公司淨利成長。不過，各家公司獲利改善不能完全歸因於先進封裝，半導體景氣回升、既有產品需求、客戶組合、產能利用率及業外收益，同樣可能影響財報表現。
通富微電(002156-CN)上半年營收160億元人民幣，年增23%；歸屬母公司淨利17.17億元，年增316%。若排除非經常性損益，淨利為7.47億元，年增77%，顯示本業獲利確實改善，但帳面淨利增幅仍受到一次性因素放大。
在先進封裝方面，通富微電已有多項產品批量導入高效能運算及推論晶片，代表部分技術已由驗證階段轉向商業化量產出貨。公司也持續發展多晶粒堆疊封裝、共同封裝光學(CPO)、混合鍵合及高堆疊記憶體封裝，後續應觀察相關產品的營收占比、量產規模與毛利率，而不是只看技術項目數量。
長電科技(600584-CN)上半年營收195億元，年增4.9%；歸屬母公司淨利8.45億元，年增79.4%。獲利增幅明顯高於營收，可能反映高附加價值產品占比提高及產品組合改善。不過，公司目前揭露的先進封裝進度，仍以平台建置、客戶導入及驗證能力為主，尚缺少營收占比與量產規模，難以單獨估算先進封裝對獲利的貢獻。
華天科技(002185-CN)上半年營收105億元，年增35%；歸屬母公司淨利8.13億元，年增259%。公司正推動2.5D先進封裝平台擴大量產，並拓展記憶體、大尺寸覆晶球閘陣列封裝(FC-BGA)、系統級封裝(SiP)及車用電子客戶。相較仍處於送樣階段的業者，華天科技下一步要驗證的是量產規模、良率與產能利用率能否同步提高。
甬矽電子(688362-CN)則仍處於產能擴充與客戶驗證階段。公司上半年營收24.11億元，年增20%；歸屬母公司淨利3,936萬元，年增30%。2025年晶圓級封裝與覆晶封裝產品合計占營收約21%，目前晶圓級封裝測試月產能約3萬片晶圓，預計年底提高至4.5萬片。
不過，甬矽電子的2.5D先進封裝產品仍在客戶送樣驗證，尚未量產。公司2026年資本支出規畫約40億元，另計畫投入103億元興建第三期高階積體電路封裝測試項目，建設期預計長達96個月。新產能不會立即形成營收，客戶驗證時間、設備進駐與產能開出進度，以及初期折舊費用，都將影響投資回收速度。
先進封裝是透過晶粒堆疊與高密度互連，縮短晶片之間的資料傳輸距離，提高運算效能與傳輸頻寬。Yole Group預估，全球先進封裝市場規模將由2025年的550億美元，增至2031年逾1,200億美元，顯示AI運算需求正持續擴大封裝環節的產值。
但市場規模成長，不代表所有擴產業者都能取得相同比例的訂單。先進封裝涉及多道製程整合，客戶還要確認可靠度、良率與長期供貨能力。即使完成技術開發，從送樣、驗證到量產仍可能歷時數季；量產後若訂單不足或產能利用率偏低，高額設備折舊反而可能壓縮毛利率。
因此，評估中國封測廠後續獲利，不能只看是否布局2.5D、Chiplet或CPO。更具判斷價值的指標，是通過驗證的客戶與產品數量、先進封裝營收占比、量產良率、產能利用率及毛利率。只有這些指標同步改善，先進封裝需求才真正由產業趨勢轉化為公司獲利。

paras_en: September 8, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – AI and high‑performance computing demand drove the first‑half‑year revenue and profit growth of Chinese test‑fab companies overall, but the progress disclosed by each firm shows that competition in advanced packaging has moved from technology layout and equipment investment to customer validation, yield improvement and mass production. Whether this will translate into profit depends on when new products pass certification, whether capacity utilization can be raised, and whether the added gross margin can cover depreciation and fixed costs.

Statistics show that among the 21 advanced‑packaging index constituents in China, 20 recorded year‑over‑year revenue growth in the first half and 18 saw an increase in net profit attributable to the parent company. However, the profit improvement of each firm cannot be fully attributed to advanced packaging; a semiconductor market rebound, existing product demand, customer mix, capacity utilization and non‑operating income may also affect financial results.

Tongfu Microelectronics (002156‑CN) posted first‑half revenue of RMB 16.0 billion, up 23% year‑on‑year, and net profit attributable to the parent of RMB 1.717 billion, up 316%. Excluding non‑recurring items, net profit was RMB 747 million, up 77%, indicating genuine operating profit improvement, though the headline net‑profit surge was still amplified by one‑off factors.

In advanced packaging, Tongfu Microelectronics already has multiple products batch‑introduced into high‑performance computing and inference chips, indicating that some technologies have moved from validation to commercial mass‑production shipments. The company also continues to develop multi‑chip‑stack packaging, co‑packaged optics (CPO), heterogeneous bonding and high‑stack memory packaging; future focus should be on the revenue share, production scale and gross margin of these products rather than merely the number of technology items.

Changdian Technology (600584‑CN) reported first‑half revenue of RMB 19.5 billion, up 4.9% year‑on‑year, and net profit attributable to the parent of RMB 845 million, up 79.4%. The profit rise outpaced revenue growth, possibly reflecting a higher share of high‑value‑added products and an improved product mix. However, the company’s disclosed advanced‑packaging progress still centers on platform building, customer onboarding and validation capability, lacking revenue share and production scale data, making it difficult to isolate the profit contribution of advanced packaging.

Huaten Technology (002185‑CN) posted first‑half revenue of RMB 10.5 billion, up 35% year‑on‑year, and net profit attributable to the parent of RMB 813 million, up 259%. The firm is pushing a 2.5D advanced‑packaging platform toward larger‑scale production and expanding into memory, large‑size flip‑chip ball‑grid‑array (FC‑BGA), system‑in‑package (SiP) and automotive‑electronics customers. Compared with peers still in the sample‑submission stage, Huaten’s next step is to verify whether production volume, yield and capacity utilization can improve together.

Yongxi Electronics (688362‑CN) remains in capacity‑expansion and customer‑validation stages. It posted first‑half revenue of RMB 2.411 billion, up 20% year‑on‑year, and net profit attributable to the parent of RMB 39.36 million, up 30%. In 2025, wafer‑level packaging and flip‑chip packaging together accounted for about 21% of its revenue; its current wafer‑level packaging test capacity is roughly 30,000 wafers per month, expected to rise to 45,000 by year‑end.

However, Yongxi’s 2.5D advanced‑packaging products are still undergoing customer sample validation and have not entered mass production. The company plans about RMB 4.0 billion in capital expenditures for 2026 and an additional RMB 10.3 billion to build a Phase‑3 high‑end IC packaging test project, with a construction period estimated at 96 months. The new capacity will not generate immediate revenue; the timing of customer validation, equipment installation, capacity ramp‑up and early depreciation will all affect the speed of investment recovery.

Advanced packaging shortens data‑transfer distances between chips by stacking dies and using high‑density interconnects, boosting computing performance and bandwidth. Yole Group estimates the global advanced‑packaging market will grow from USD 55 billion in 2025 to over USD 120 billion by 2031, reflecting the expanding AI‑compute demand for the packaging segment.

But market‑size growth does not guarantee that every expanding player will capture the same proportion of orders. Advanced packaging involves multiple process integrations, and customers must verify reliability, yield and long‑term supply capability. Even after technology development, moving from sample submission and validation to mass production can take several quarters; if orders are insufficient or capacity utilization remains low after ramp‑up, high equipment depreciation may compress gross margins.

Therefore, assessing the future profitability of Chinese test‑fab firms cannot rely solely on whether they have a 2.5D, chiplet or CPO roadmap. More telling indicators are the number of customers and products that have passed validation, the revenue share of advanced packaging, mass‑production yield, capacity utilization and gross margin. Only when these metrics improve together does advanced‑packaging demand truly translate from an industry trend into corporate profit.

items.title: 美股亮起155年僅見兩次的警訊 巴菲特一句話示警
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Light Up a Warning Seen Only Twice in 155 Years, Buffett Issues a Cautionary Remark
paras: 標普 500 指數過去幾年強勢攀升，人工智慧（AI）類股更成為這波多頭行情的領頭羊。過去三個曆年，這項知名指標累計上漲 78%，今年漲勢大致延續，全年升幅可望達到 13%。
這波行情讓許多投資人斬獲頗豐，但全球最成功的投資人之一，卻不太滿意目前看到的景象。
「股神」巴菲特執掌波克夏海瑟威（Berkshire Hathaway）長達 60 年，締造持續超越大盤的亮眼績效。這位億萬富豪已於今年初卸下執行長職務，但仍擔任董事長，並持續參與投資決策。
隨著股市亮起 155 年來僅出現過兩次的警訊，巴菲特也提高警覺。在此背景下，這位投資傳奇向投資人發出直白警告。
錯過當年的輝達？罕見訊號再度浮現
2009 年，一項「加倍押注」訊號曾在當時名不見經傳的晶片製造商輝達(NVDA-US) 身上出現。如今，這項「完全信服」訊號多年來首度再現，指向一家規模僅有輝達百分之一的公司。
首先簡單回顧巴菲特的投資策略。巴菲特素有「奧馬哈先知」之稱，他之所以能創造驚人報酬，關鍵在於無論市場環境如何變化，始終堅守一套投資原則。
巴菲特主張以合理價格買進優質股票，尤其偏好逢低撿便宜，並長期持有。投資可口可樂便是典型案例。他在 1980 年代末期開始買進這家飲料巨擘的股票，此後一路持有至今。事實上，可口可樂(KO-US) 目前仍是波克夏海瑟威前五大持股之一。
這位頂尖投資人也不容易受到他人影響，因此不會盲目追隨市場趨勢。在多頭市場中，他不會急著追買當紅股票；在空頭市場中，也不會倉促逃離股市。
事實上，巴菲特經常逆勢而行，尋找暫時失寵、或尚未獲得市場青睞的優質股票。他的投資邏輯，是在價格合理時及早布局，待其他投資人日後發掘這些股票的價值，再從中受益。
AI熱潮推升股市估值、席勒本益比突破41倍
再來看看當前市場環境，以及巴菲特近期提出的警告。如前所述，在 AI 革命與整體偏多氛圍推動下，標普 500 指數大幅上漲。與此同時，通膨升溫疑慮與伊朗局勢動盪等逆風，也曾一度壓抑市場動能。
不過，市場整體持續走高，已帶來一項格外值得注意的結果：股市正亮起 155 年來僅出現過兩次的警訊，也就是股票已處於歷史高價。
標普 500 指數的席勒循環調整本益比（Shiller CAPE）已突破 41 倍。過去只有一次達到這種水準，發生在網路泡沫時期。
席勒循環調整本益比是具參考價值的估值指標，透過比較股價與過去 10 年每股盈餘的關係，降低景氣波動造成的影響。
如今這項指標顯示，美股估值已升至極高水準，而歷史經驗顯示，股市觸及類似高檔後，往往會出現回落。
就在幾個月前，巴菲特接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，許多市場參與者正在「賭博」，而這種「賭博氣氛」已升至高峰。
巴菲特說：「如果你買賣的是一天到期的選擇權，那既不是投資，也不是投機，而是賭博。」
市場上的這股風氣，加上目前居高不下的估值，可能使股市重演過去常見的走勢，也就是由高檔向下修正。
現在該買進標普500指數嗎
這對當前投資人意味著什麼？這並不代表投資人應該逃離市場。相反地，一如往常，買進股票前仍應評估其估值、公司的財務體質，以及長期發展前景。
只要確實做好這些功課，並抱持長期持有的決心，就等於採取巴菲特式投資策略，也可能在任何市場環境中找到機會。
在買進標普 500 指數前，不妨先思考以下一點。
Motley Fool旗下 Stock Advisor 分析團隊近期選出他們認為目前最值得投資人買進的 10 檔股票，標普 500 指數並未入選。這 10 檔股票未來幾年可能創造驚人報酬。
以網飛(NFLX-US) 為例，該股於 2004 年 12 月 17 日入選這份名單。若當時依照建議投入 1,000 美元，如今資產將達到 421,997 美元。輝達則在 2005 年 4 月 15 日入選，當時投入的 1,000 美元，如今將成長至 1,413,876 美元。
值得注意的是，Stock Advisor 的平均總報酬率達 978%，遠高於標普 500 指數的 213%。投資人可透過 Stock Advisor 查看最新十大推薦名單，並加入由個人投資人為個人投資人打造的投資社群。
paras_en: The S&P 500 has surged strongly in recent years, with AI stocks leading the current bull market. Over the past three calendar years, this well‑known index has risen 78%, and this year’s rally appears set to continue, with a full‑year gain potentially reaching 13%.
The rally has rewarded many investors handsomely, but one of the world’s most successful investors is less satisfied with what he sees today.

‘The Oracle of Omaha’ Warren Buffett has run Berkshire Hathaway for 60 years, delivering performance that consistently outpaces the market. The billionaire stepped down as CEO earlier this year but remains chairman and continues to take part in investment decisions.
With the market flashing a warning that has only appeared twice in the past 155 years, Buffett is on high alert. Against this backdrop, the investing legend has issued a blunt warning to investors.
Missed Nvidia back then? A rare signal re‑emerges

In 2009 a “double‑down” signal showed up on the then‑obscure chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA‑US). Today that same “full‑conviction” signal has resurfaced for the first time in years, pointing to a company only about one‑percent the size of Nvidia.
First, a brief recap of Buffett’s investment approach. Known as the “Omaha Prophet,” Buffett’s extraordinary returns stem from sticking to a core set of principles regardless of market conditions.

Buffett advocates buying quality stocks at reasonable prices, especially favoring bargains on dips and holding them for the long term. His investment in Coca‑Cola is a classic example. He began buying the beverage giant’s shares in the late 1980s and has held them ever since. In fact, Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) remains one of Berkshire Hathaway’s top‑five holdings.

The legendary investor is not easily swayed by others, so he does not blindly follow market trends. In a bull market he won’t rush to chase hot stocks; in a bear market he won’t hastily flee equities.

In fact, Buffett often goes against the grain, seeking temporarily out‑of‑favor or still‑unappreciated quality stocks. His logic is to position early when prices are reasonable, then profit as other investors later discover the stocks’ value.
AI hype lifts market valuations, Shiller CAPE tops 41‑times

Now let’s look at the current market environment and Buffett’s recent warning. As noted, the AI revolution and an overall bullish sentiment have driven the S&P 500 sharply higher. At the same time, inflation worries and geopolitical turbulence in Iran have at times dampened market momentum.

Nevertheless, the market’s overall upward trajectory has produced a noteworthy outcome: the stock market is flashing a warning that has only occurred twice in the past 155 years, meaning stocks are at historically high levels.
The S&P 500’s Shiller cyclically‑adjusted price‑to‑earnings ratio (CAPE) has broken above 41‑times earnings. It has only reached that level once before, during the dot‑com bubble.
The Shiller CAPE is a useful valuation metric that compares current prices to earnings over the past ten years, smoothing out business‑cycle volatility.
Today the indicator shows U.S. equities are priced at an extremely high level, and history suggests that markets tend to pull back after reaching such lofty valuations.
A few months ago, Buffett told CNBC that many market participants are “gambling,” and that this gambling atmosphere has peaked.
Buffett said, “If you’re trading options that expire in one day, that’s neither investing nor speculation—it’s gambling.”
This prevailing mindset, combined with persistently lofty valuations, could cause the market to repeat a familiar pattern of correcting from lofty peaks.
Should you buy the S&P 500 now?

What does this mean for today’s investors? It does not mean they should flee the market. On the contrary, as always, buying stocks still requires evaluating valuation, a company’s financial health, and long‑term prospects.
If you do the homework and commit to holding for the long term, you are essentially following a Buffett‑style strategy, which can uncover opportunities in any market environment.
Before buying the S&P 500, consider this point.

Motley Fool’s Stock Advisor team recently selected the ten stocks they believe are the best buys right now, and the S&P 500 did not make the list. Those ten picks could generate spectacular returns over the next few years.

Take Netflix (NFLX‑US) as an example: it was added to the list on December 17 2004. An investment of $1,000 at that time would now be worth $421,997. Nvidia made the list on April 15 2005; a $1,000 investment then would have grown to $1,413,876 today.

items.title: EUR/USD：歐元等待ECB升息，油價逼近100美元；美元也陷入沉寂
items.title_en: EUR/USD: Euro Awaits ECB Rate Hike, Oil Near $100; Dollar Also Quiet
paras: 要點：

歐元在1.16美元附近持穩
交易員關注ECB升息
油價為整體市場情緒帶來壓力


歐洲的能源衝擊顯示，週四可能需要採取更緊縮的貨幣政策。強勁的美國非農就業數據也重新點燃了市場對聯準會升息的預期。

歐元在週四利率決議前維持穩定


週一，EURUSD維持在1.16美元附近，儘管全球利率預期出現大幅重新定價，歐元仍沒有太大波動。
貨幣對的平靜走勢反映多股力量的拉鋸：市場預期歐洲央行本週升息，可能支撐歐元；另一方面，週五強勁的美國就業數據則強化了美元的殖利率優勢。
市場普遍預期ECB將於週四把存款利率上調25個基點至2.50%。這將是自6月政策制定者開始因應能源推動的通膨以來，第二次升息。
歐元區8月通膨率從2.9% 加速至3.3%，主要受到能源價格上漲推動。排除波動較大的食品與燃料價格後，核心通膨率則降至2.4%。


油價讓 ECB 的政策訊息更加複雜


週末美國與伊朗在荷姆茲海峽附近攻擊船隻後，布蘭特原油價格一度逼近97美元。途經該航線的航運量大幅下降，增加長期運輸中斷的風險。
歐洲高度依賴能源進口，因此高油價對當地家庭與企業尤其不利。
升息決策本身可能已幾乎完全反映在市場價格中，因此歐元更大的反應可能來自Christine Lagarde的政策指引。
偏鷹派的政策展望 — 也就是暗示利率可能進一步上升的措辭 — 可能推高歐洲債券殖利率並支撐歐元。相反地，若釋放出謹慎的「升息一次就結束」訊息，可能使歐元走弱。


CPI 決定美元的下一步


在大西洋彼岸，美國8月新增162,000個工作職位，接近市場預期56,000個的三倍，而失業率維持在4.1%。交易員目前認為聯準會下週升息的機率約為57%。
美國生產者物價指數（PPI）將於週四公佈，消費者物價指數（CPI）則於週五公佈。若通膨數據偏高，將強化聯準會升息的理由，可能推動歐元兌美元跌破1.16美元，進一步測試1.1550與1.1500附近的支撐。
若通膨數據低於預期，則可能挑戰美元多頭，讓該貨幣對再次測試1.1660–1.1700。值得注意的是，儘管非農就業數據強勁、升息預期升溫，美元週一的漲幅仍然有限。
美國財政疑慮，以及海灣地區衝突可能帶來的通膨影響，似乎正在限制美元的需求。即使週一美國民眾放假休市，市場也早已很難再享受平靜的數據日曆。


#TradingView
paras_en: Key points: Euro holds near $1.16, traders watch for an ECB rate hike, and oil prices pressure overall market sentiment. Europe’s energy shock suggests tighter monetary policy may be needed on Thursday, while strong U.S. non‑farm payroll data reignites expectations of a Fed rate hike.

The euro remained stable around $1.16 on Thursday ahead of the rate decision. Despite a major repricing of global rate expectations, the EUR/USD pair showed little movement. The calm price action reflects a tug‑of‑war: markets expect the European Central Bank to raise rates this week, which could support the euro, while Friday’s strong U.S. jobs data bolsters the dollar’s yield advantage. The consensus is that the ECB will lift the deposit rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on Thursday – the second hike since policymakers began reacting to energy‑driven inflation in June. Euro‑area inflation accelerated from 2.9% to 3.3% in August, driven mainly by higher energy prices, while core inflation (excluding volatile food and fuel) fell to 2.4%.

Oil prices add complexity to the ECB’s policy signal. After U.S. and Iranian attacks on vessels near the Hormuz Strait over the weekend, Brent crude briefly approached $97 per barrel, and shipping traffic through the strait has sharply declined, raising the risk of prolonged transport disruptions. Europe’s heavy reliance on imported energy makes high oil prices especially harmful to households and businesses. The rate‑rise decision itself is likely already priced in, so the euro’s next move may hinge on Christine Lagarde’s guidance. A more hawkish outlook – hinting further rate hikes – could push European bond yields higher and support the euro, whereas a cautious “one‑time hike only” message could weaken it. In the U.S., August added 162,000 jobs, nearly three times the 56,000 forecast, with unemployment steady at 4.1%. Traders see about a 57% chance of a Fed hike next week. The PPI is due Thursday and CPI on Friday; higher‑than‑expected inflation would reinforce a Fed hike, potentially pulling EUR/USD below 1.16 and testing support around 1.1550‑1.1500. Lower inflation could challenge the dollar’s rally and let the pair retest 1.1660‑1.1700. Despite strong payrolls and rising rate‑hike expectations, the dollar’s gain on Monday was modest. Fiscal concerns in the U.S. and inflation risks from Middle‑East conflicts appear to be capping dollar demand, and even with a U.S. holiday, markets are finding it hard to enjoy a quiet data calendar.

items.title: 升息預期+交易量萎縮 日元強升創下半年新高
items.title_en: Rate‑Hike Expectations and Shrinking Trading Volume Push Yen to Half‑Year High
paras: 日元兌美元匯率周一(7日)強漲，急升至半年多以來新高，領漲非美貨幣。
交易數據顯示，日元兌美元匯率周一一度擴大漲幅達 1.4%，最高升至 154.06，創下自 2026 年 2 月 23 日以來的最強紀錄，並成功衝破 155 這一關鍵防線。由於美國適逢勞動節假期休市，全球交易量顯著萎縮，清淡的市況進一步放大了匯率的波動，使得短線走勢更為劇烈。
推動此輪日元反彈的核心動力，在於市場對日本央行(BOJ)將採取更積極貨幣政策的強烈預期。 市場目前高度聚焦 9 月 18 日的日銀利率決策，積極押注日銀屆時將升息 25 個基點。日本央行審議委員高田創先前的發言更助長了升息情緒，他透露連續升息不無可能。
此外，日本政府年金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的傳聞、月初實質資金的常態性重新配置，以及原油價格下跌改善日本貿易條件，皆為日元提供了關鍵支持。
技術面上，日元成功突破 155 心理關卡，被視為多空逆轉的重要信號。 投資機構 State Street 策略師 Loo 指出，155 關卡在過去官方干預時曾作為日元底部的「地板」，破位極具指標性。一旦匯價衝破該關卡，隨即觸發了下方龐大的止損單，迫使期權交易商拋售美元，進而加劇日元漲幅。
三菱日聯信託銀行外匯交易主管Motonari Sakai表示，若日元升破 154 低點，下一個目標恐將直指 152 日元區間。
與此同時，日本官方先前為了捍衛日元所付出的巨額代價也隨之曝光。日本財務省最新數據揭露，截至 8 月底，日本持有的外國證券頭寸創紀錄地暴跌了 878 億美元，直接用於資助近期干預。在截至 8 月 26 日的一整個月內，東京當局共砸下創紀錄的 15.4 兆日元(約合 98.6 億美元)支持本國貨幣。
儘管日元上周已升值 2.4%，日本最高外匯官員三村淳強調防守姿態並未改變。Russell Investments 策略主管 Van Luu 分析指出，此輪上漲更多是由市場「有機」驅動，顯得更有意義。
paras_en: The yen surged against the dollar on Monday (the 7th), jumping to a new high not seen in more than six months and leading the rally among non‑U.S. currencies.

Trading data showed the yen‑dollar pair briefly expanded its gain to 1.4% on Monday, peaking at 154.06 – the strongest level since February 23, 2026 – and successfully breaking the critical 155 barrier. Because the United States was closed for the Labor Day holiday, global trading volume contracted sharply, and the thin market amplified the exchange‑rate swings, making the short‑term move even more volatile.

The core driver of this yen rebound is the market’s strong expectation that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) will adopt a more aggressive monetary policy. Market participants are now focused on the BOJ’s rate decision on September 18 and are betting that the central bank will raise rates by 25 basis points. Comments earlier from BOJ policy‑maker Takata Sōsen, who said a series of hikes is not out of the question, further fueled the rate‑hike sentiment.

In addition, rumours that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its asset allocation, routine re‑allocation of real funds at the start of the month, and lower oil prices improving Japan’s trade conditions have all provided key support for the yen.

On the technical side, the yen’s break above the 155 psychological level is seen as an important signal of a bullish reversal. State Street strategist Loo noted that the 155 mark has historically acted as a “floor” during official interventions, so a break is highly indicative. Once the price pierced that level, a large wave of stop‑loss orders below was triggered, forcing options dealers to sell dollars and further accelerating the yen’s rise.
Mitsubishi UFJ Trust Bank’s FX trading head Motonari Sakai said that if the yen clears the 154 low, the next target could be the 152‑yen range.

At the same time, the huge cost Japan has incurred to defend the yen has been disclosed. Ministry of Finance data show that by the end of August, Japan’s foreign‑securities holdings had plunged by a record $87.8 billion, directly used to fund recent interventions. Over the full month ending August 26, Tokyo authorities spent a record ¥15.4 trillion (about $9.86 billion) to support the domestic currency.

Although the yen appreciated 2.4% last week, Japan’s top foreign‑exchange official Jun Mimura stressed that the defensive stance has not changed. Russell Investments strategy head Van Luu argued that this rally is largely “organic” market‑driven, making it more meaningful.

items.title: 〈台幣〉偏強整理創近3個月高點 升值7.8分收31.552元
items.title_en: TWD Strengthens, Consolidates Near 3‑Month High, Gains 7.8 ¢ to 31.552
paras: 儘管目前市場預期美國聯準會9月升息機率過半，不過，隨著資金再度簇擁AI相關電子股，台股加權指數今(7)日強彈775點，新台幣早盤升貶互見，午盤過後越走越強，一度創6月中旬以來新高，終場收在31.552元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值18.32億美元。
新台幣今日以31.61元、升值2分開出後，早盤升貶互見低見31.651元，但午盤過後偏強，最高來到31.505元，全日高低價差1.46角。
觀察主要亞幣全面走升，以日元飆升0.7%最多，其次為新台幣收升0.25%，韓元升0.2%左右，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣和星元小升0.05%上下，美元指數小貶0.1%左右。
國泰證期研究部指出，美國 8 月非農就業人口大增 16.2 萬人，遠高於市場預期的 5.6 萬人，且 7 月數據大幅上修至增加 2.1 萬人， 強韌的就業數據推升緊縮預期，CME FedWatch 顯示 9 月升息 1 碼機率跳升至約 60%。
而本周市場焦點轉向即將公布的美國 CPI和PPI 數據，通膨走勢將成為聯準會利率決策分水嶺，仍須留意市場對高利率恐維持更久的擔憂。
paras_en: Despite market expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve has more than a 50% chance of raising rates in September, the Taiwan weighted index surged 775 points today (the 7th), as funds once again flocked to AI‑related semiconductor stocks. The New Taiwan dollar fluctuated in the early session but grew stronger after lunch, briefly hitting a new high not seen since mid‑June and closing at 31.552, a 7.8‑cent appreciation, with Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers handling $1.832 billion in turnover.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.61, up 2 cents, and slipped to a low of 31.651 in the early session, but after lunch it turned bullish, reaching a high of 31.505, with the day's high‑low spread at 1.46 ¢.

Major Asian currencies were broadly higher, led by the Japanese yen which jumped 0.7%. The New Taiwan dollar rose 0.25%, the Korean won about 0.2%, the Thai baht more than 0.1%, while the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each edged up roughly 0.05%; the U.S. dollar index fell about 0.1%.

Citi Securities Research noted that U.S. non‑farm payrolls surged by 162,000 in August, far exceeding the market’s 56,000 forecast, and July’s figure was sharply revised up by 21,000. The robust employment data lifted tightening expectations, and CME FedWatch shows the probability of a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September jumping to roughly 60%.

This week’s market focus shifts to the upcoming U.S. CPI and PPI releases, as inflation trends will be a watershed for the Fed’s rate‑setting decisions, and investors remain wary of concerns that high rates may need to be maintained longer than expected.

items.title: 半導體強勁與外資湧入 韓元匯率衝上兩年高點
items.title_en: Strong Semiconductor Momentum and Foreign Inflows Push Won to Two-Year High
paras: 韓元兌美元匯率周一(7日)強升，匯率一度上漲1.3%，至1,334.70韓元，創下自2024年10月，接近兩年以來新高。
近期韓元的反彈力道極為強勁，相較於2026年7月的低點，韓元已大幅回升了約250韓元，今年以來的累計升幅則達到約6%。
本次韓元強勢上漲主要受到多重利多因素推動。其中，強勁的出口貿易奠定了堅實基礎。今年以來，南韓累計出口額已創下7,094億美元的歷史新高，提前外加超越2025年全年的紀錄。其中，受惠於人工智慧(AI)晶片需求引爆，1至8月半導體出口額大幅增長了169.6%。
其次，外資持續湧入股市提供關鍵動能，周一外資大舉買入超過8,000億韓元(約5.98億美元)的南韓Kospi指數成份股，這已是外資連續第三個交易日淨流入，並由三星電子與SK海力士等半導體巨頭領漲。
此外，出口商累積了大量外匯收益並延遲兌換，使南韓五大銀行的企業美元存款攀升至約770億美元的歷史新高。
儘管市場對聯準會9月升息的預期升至57%至60%之間，這可能為韓元帶來一定阻力，但外資對南韓資產的持續需求仍為匯率提供強大支撐。
不過，分析師也指出，未來的升值步伐可能會面臨挑戰。紐約梅隆銀行高級策略師 Geoffrey Yu 表示，隨著韓元漲勢顯得越發緊繃，可能會促使南韓國內資產管理機構解除部分海外資產的避險部位，或是推動南韓散戶重啟海外股票投資。
paras_en: The won‑dollar exchange rate surged sharply on Monday (the 7th), rising as much as 1.3% to 1,334.70 won, marking the highest level since October 2024 and a near two‑year peak.
The won’s recent rebound has been exceptionally strong; compared with its low in July 2026, it has recovered by roughly 250 won, and the cumulative gain this year is about 6%.

The current won rally is driven by multiple bullish factors. Robust export trade has laid a solid foundation, with South Korea’s cumulative exports this year reaching a record $709.4 billion, already surpassing the full‑year record for 2025. In particular, AI chip demand has spurred a 169.6% surge in semiconductor exports from January to August.

In addition, continued foreign inflows into the equity market have provided key momentum. On Monday, foreign investors bought more than 8 trillion won (about $598 million) of KOSPI constituent stocks, marking the third consecutive day of net foreign purchases, led by semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

Furthermore, exporters have accumulated large foreign‑exchange earnings and delayed conversion, pushing corporate dollar deposits at South Korea’s five major banks to a historic high of roughly $77 billion.

Although market expectations for a Fed rate hike in September have risen to between 57% and 60%, potentially weighing on the won, sustained foreign demand for South Korean assets continues to underpin the currency strongly.

Analysts caution that the appreciation pace may face challenges ahead. BNY Mellon senior strategist Geoffrey Yu noted that as the won’s rally tightens, domestic asset managers might unwind some overseas hedges and retail investors could resume overseas stock investments.

items.title: 日元行情正在好轉 兌歐元、英鎊與瑞郎率先走強
items.title_en: Yen Moves Higher, Leading Gains Against Euro, Pound and Franc
paras: 外匯交易員對日元的看法日益樂觀，這項轉變率先反映在主要交叉匯率。日元近期兌歐元、瑞士法郎及英鎊走強，相關漲勢可能進一步延伸至美元，帶動美元兌日元匯率續跌。
日本當局實際干預與口頭干預接連出現，加上市場對日本央行升息的預期升溫，正逐步改善日元的整體環境。另一方面，日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能將更多海外資金匯回國內、轉進日本債券，也成為支撐日元的潛在因素。
值得注意的是，在美元兌日元上周跌至155關卡前夕，投機交易員一度增加日元淨空頭部位，但這些部位可能已經大幅削減。由於歐元及瑞郎淨空頭部位仍處低檔，也讓交易員在日本央行公布利率決策前，仍有充足空間透過交叉匯率建立日元多頭部位。
隨著市場對日本央行轉向鷹派的預期升高，投資人將關注9月18日的利率決策是否以9比0全票通過升息，以及行長植田和男會後是否保留10月再次升息的可能性。
此外，隨著日元逼近155關口，空頭踩踏風險急劇升溫。摩根大通策略師田中俊雅等人警告，若美元兌日元貶破155，龐大的空頭部位恐被逼加速解除，引發連鎖賣盤。
根據摩根大通估計，目前仍有約16至17兆日元的看空部位尚未平倉，若完全解除，理論上可能將匯價推入142至146區間，但其基準判斷仍是美元兌日元處於155至165區間。
另一重大不確定性來自日本官方。最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，對近期日元走勢「既不滿意，也沒有感到安心」，日本仍處「高度警戒狀態」，被解讀為可能繼續干預的訊號。
分析人士認為，9月18日BOJ會議後恰逢「白銀周」假期，流動性下降，不排除當局利用此時段行動。
paras_en: Forex traders are becoming increasingly optimistic about the yen, a shift first reflected in the major cross‑rates. The yen has recently strengthened against the euro, Swiss franc and pound, and the rally could extend to the dollar, pushing the USD/JPY rate lower further.

Actual and verbal interventions by Japanese authorities have appeared in succession, and rising market expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike are gradually improving the yen’s overall environment. Meanwhile, the Government Pension Investment Fund may repatriate more overseas assets into domestic Japanese bonds, providing another potential support for the yen.

It is noteworthy that, just before the dollar‑yen slipped to the 155 level last week, speculative traders briefly increased net short positions in the yen, but those positions have likely been cut sharply. Because net short positions on the euro and franc remain low, traders still have ample room to build yen long positions via cross‑rates before the BOJ announces its rate decision.

With market expectations rising that the BOJ will turn hawkish, investors will watch whether the September 18 rate decision is approved unanimously 9‑0 and whether Governor Kazuo Ueda will keep the option of another hike in October after the meeting.

Furthermore, as the yen approaches the 155 threshold, the risk of a short‑covering squeeze is heating up. JPMorgan strategists such as Toshimasa Tanaka warned that if USD/JPY falls below 155, the massive short side could be forced to unwind rapidly, triggering a cascade of sell orders.

JPMorgan estimates that about ¥16‑17 trillion of short positions remain open; if fully unwound, the yen could theoretically be pushed into the 142‑146 range, although its baseline view still places USD/JPY in the 155‑165 band.

A further major uncertainty comes from Japanese officials. Senior foreign‑exchange official Jun Mimura said he is “neither satisfied nor reassured” by the recent yen moves and that Japan remains in a “high‑alert state,” a comment read as a possible signal of continued intervention.
Analysts note that the BOJ meeting on September 18 falls during the “Silver Week” holiday, when liquidity drops, and it cannot be ruled out that authorities might act during that window.

◆GBP/USD

Markets trimmed bets on a Fed hike this month, suppressing the dollar last Friday.
